content.short: Gives any AI agent its own wallet, lives in chat apps, and lets agents pay each other.
content.description: Pieverse sets up a Web3-native AI agent inside chat apps like Line, KakaoTalk, WhatsApp and Telegram, taking care of wallet creation and key custody in a secure enclave. The agent keeps its identity and skills across runtimes such as Claude Code and Codex, and can be extended from a skill store. Its agent-to-agent layer lets agents hire and pay one another over gasless x402b rails, with on-chain invoices and receipts.
content.meta: Pieverse gives AI agents a wallet in chat apps like Line and WhatsApp, plus skills and gasless agent-to-agent payments.
